title: Old VX Ace Project Iconset Utility Game

posts.author: Silenity
posts.body: Okay, maybe I'm showing my rpg maker age here but there used to be a VX Ace project that was a game that let you split and merge iconsets. Does anyone at all remember what I'm talking about? I can't for the life of me find it.

posts.author: Archeia
posts.body:
I think I know exactly which one you are talking about. It's probably the one I had on my site?
Icon and Face Utility
Icon and Face Utility Half a Life Introduction This script merges or disassembles your icon or face resources automatically. Useful if you don’t want to spend most of your time aligning faces…
